phase2Ratchet.toolchain: Bun 1.3.14; replica-e2e Node size job Rust 1.99.0; production webpack; gzip -9 -c

rationale.requiredAtLoad: The web root exports the Node class. Its synchronous sign-out delivery denial, TC-1208 epoch/attempt/signOutCount fences and independent non-replica OpenKey retry cannot move behind an asynchronous replica loader. The measured whole-file marginal includes OpenKey and gzip interactions; it is not a replica-only charge.

The root owns the explicit enabled-constructor registration and synchronous invalid-config refusal; sign-in/restore and wallet selection retain the TC-1208 fences. The optional recovery, storage, authority and worker remain outside the root.

The separately built optional entry calls the root's existing SDK parser and SIWE helpers through these exports, sharing one registry/session and avoiding a second copy of SDK code. This marginal overlaps the index.ts/tcw.ts row and must not be summed.
